description: NiO AFM-II, SCAN0r: orbital-tau SCAN exchange and correlation everywhere (TYPE='SCAN', TSCANDELOC=T) plus 25% onsite exact exchange on Ni and O, double counting with the same TSCAN exchange (no DCTYPE override). Added 2026-10-03; DAV, RMM and friction MD must agree. Until the route-1 stall is fixed only the Davidson run is executed (it documents the stall); RMM and friction MD will be added back with the fix.

defaults.@NINTBO@:
!NTBO NOFL=1 1 1 CV=T
          TAILLAMBDA=4. 2. RAUG/RCOV=0.6
          RTAIL/RCOV=0.8 RTAILCUT/RCOV=2. !END

subs.@PSIDYN@:
STOP=F FRIC=0.02 SAFEORTHO=T
    !AUTO FRIC(-)=0.3 FACT(-)=0.97 FRIC(+)=0.3 FACT(+)=1. MINFRIC=0.02 !END

known_issues.dav_var: SCAN0r (orbital-tau SCAN + onsite exact exchange) does not converge with route 1: from the first variational step the residual stays at 2.95e-4, 254 of 297 steps are rejected and 42 re-anchored, the energy wanders by ~6 meV around -3060.435 eV (NiO, 2026-10-03). TSCAN alone (nio_tscan) and PBE-SL0r converge, so the potential of the TSCAN onsite double counting is probably not the exact derivative of its energy. Open; to be diagnosed with an energy-vs-potential check.
